label: S2-M1 execAnns folds right-to-left
old:
| a :: as =>
    match π.execAnn ops n M a with
    | .ok M' => execAnns n.succ M' as
    | res => res
new:
| a :: as =>
    match execAnns n.succ M as with
    | .ok M' => π.execAnn ops n M' a
    | res => res

label: S2-M2 failure reports the partial memory, not the pre-command memory
old:
| .semFail o => .failed o pc M
    | .stuck => .stuck pc M
new:
| .semFail o => .failed o pc (cmd.foldl (fun M' a => match π.expand.execAnn ops (π.offset pc) M' a with | .ok M'' => M'' | _ => M') M)
    | .stuck => .stuck pc M

label: S2-M3 every annotation reads the pre-command memory
old:
| .ok M' => execAnns n.succ M' as
    | res => res
new:
| .ok _ => execAnns n.succ M as
    | res => res

label: S2-M4 offset off by one (equivalent at fixture level)
S2-M5 checkPlanF is the slice-1 checker on the unexpanded plan
S2-M6 FValid weakened to slice-1 Valid of the fused plan
S2-M7 terminal_adequacy_F drops the FValid hypothesis
S2-M8 terminal_adequacy_F reports the expanded command count
old: m = π.commands.length ∧ ∃ c, π.refState ops η m = some c
new: m = π.expand.commands.length ∧ ∃ c, π.refState ops η m = some c

label: S2-M9 checkPlanF skips the expansion (slice-1 checker minus singleton)
new:
def checkPlanF (π : P.Plan) : Bool :=
  π.checkCov1Nodup && π.checkCov1Complete && π.checkCov2Nodup && π.checkCov2Complete && π.checkSteps

label: S2-M10 Agree drops the final-memory equality of done runs
S2-M11 Agree drops the failing-occurrence equality
S2-M12 expand reverses annotation order within each command
old: def expand : P.Plan := { π with commands := π.ann.map (fun a => [a]) }
new: def expand : P.Plan := { π with commands := (π.commands.flatMap List.reverse).map (fun a => [a]) }

label: S2-M13 expand drops the first annotation of each fused command
old: def expand : P.Plan := { π with commands := π.ann.map (fun a => [a]) }
new: def expand : P.Plan := { π with commands := (π.commands.flatMap (fun c => if c.length > 1 then c.drop 1 else c)).map (fun a => [a]) }

label: S2-M14 offset counts commands instead of annotations
S2-M15 execAnns on the empty command is stuck, not a no-op
old:
| [] => .ok M
  | a :: as =>
    match π.execAnn ops n M a with
new:
| [] => .stuck
  | a :: as =>
    match π.execAnn ops n M a with
